findings.title: GetWebAssets does not re-check the cache after acquiring the write lock
findings.body: The fast path reads entryPointAssetsCache under RLock, but once it sees nil it releases and later calls Lock without re-reading the cache. Multiple goroutines that observed nil before the first writer populated the cache will all enter the slow path serially, each opening and parsing the manifest while holding the exclusive lock. If one of those later reloads fails, it can overwrite an already-valid cache with nil, causing subsequent requests to retry and potentially fail. After acquiring Lock, the function should re-check entryPointAssetsCache (and return it when cfg.Env != setting.Dev) before doing any I/O.

findings.title: No concurrent regression test for the data race fix
findings.body: This change adds synchronization to GetWebAssets but no test exercises concurrent calls. A race-enabled test that calls GetWebAssets from multiple goroutines and accesses the returned assets would help detect a regression back to unsynchronized access of the global entryPointAssetsCache.
